title: Dynamic polymer with hybrid cross-linked network and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic polymer with a hybrid cross-linking network, which comprises common covalent cross-linking and dynamic covalent cross-linking, wherein the dynamic covalent cross-linking is realized by organic boric acid silicone bonds. The dynamic polymer combines the advantages of dynamic covalent organic boric acid silicon ester bonds and common covalent bonds, and can prepare polymers with rich structures and various performances by regulating and controlling the structures of reactants. The dynamic covalent crosslinking in the dynamic polymer has strong dynamic reversibility, so that the polymer can show the functional characteristics of stimulus responsiveness, self-repairability and the like, and the common covalent crosslinking endows the polymer with certain strength and stability; in addition, the dynamism of the organic boric acid silicon ester bond can generate good energy dissipation and energy absorption effects, and the material is toughened, damped and impacted in a specific structure. The dynamic polymer can be used for manufacturing shock absorption buffer materials, impact resistance protection materials, self-repairing materials, toughness materials and the like.
